pass_a_gloss: Secret martyrdom: pure conscience crowned; daily death.
pass_b_english: But not the open martyrdom alone: secretly too the soul is crowned that denies itself through love toward God. 'The testimony of our conscience' (Psalm 44:21–22) — this too is martyrdom before God, who 'knoweth the secrets of the heart.' (1 Corinthians 15:31) For 'for thy sake we are killed all the day' (2 Corinthians 1:12) — the daily death of the self-denied. Blessed then are the pure in conscience, whether before tribunals or in secret, for God seeth in secret and rewardeth.
